description: This file defines the FingerprintUiHelper class, which manages the UI interactions and callbacks for fingerprint authentication in an Android app. It handles starting and stopping fingerprint listening, updating UI elements based on authentication results, and provides a callback interface for authentication events.

classes.name: FingerprintUiHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing fingerprint authentication UI, handling callbacks and updating the fingerprint icon and text view based on authentication status.

methods.name: isFingerprintAuthAvailable
methods.description: Checks if fingerprint hardware is available and fingerprints are enrolled.

methods.name: startListening
methods.description: Begins listening for fingerprint authentication with a given crypto object.

methods.name: onAuthenticationError
methods.description: Handles authentication errors, shows error message and triggers callback.

methods.name: onAuthenticationSucceeded
methods.description: Handles successful authentication, updates UI and triggers callback.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Updates UI to show an error message and icon.
